visual.title: 观察记录，不是已发生事实

observation.text: 如果没有可核对的现实材料，你愿意先收集哪一条事实，而不是判断解释已经成立？
Without checkable reality evidence, which fact would you collect first instead of declaring the interpretation confirmed?

visual.title: 观察记录，不是已发生事实

observation.text: 记录一个情境、一项可见行动、一个结果与一个反例，并标明日期。哪些观察仍需要更多信息？
Record a situation, a visible action, an outcome and a counterexample, with dates. Which observations still need more information?

visual.title: 观察记录，不是已发生事实

observation.text: 哪一步可以低风险试行，并在何时撤回或重新评估？如果当前资料不足，也可以选择暂缓。
Which step can be tried at low risk, and when could it be withdrawn or reassessed? If information is insufficient, deferral remains an option.
你能否区分本报告中的计算、传统解释、观察问题与尚未确认的内容？这份区分比把所有描述当作事实更重要。
Can you distinguish calculation, traditional interpretation, observation questions and unresolved content in this report? That distinction matters more than treating every description as fact.

scope: Nineteen native source contracts per subject; visual refinement and approval limited to four pilot pages
